text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Bright! See that elephant over there? It's
the
biggest one in the zoo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! What a charming, looong nose it
has.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm at the zoo one weekend, when I spot
two
especially excited visitors.

text_block_list.name: Bright & Elephant
text_block_list.text: Pawooo!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yep, looks like you two are in sync!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! There's a giraffe back there! Whoa,
its neck
goes on forever!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Gah, I forgot!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Let's go see it together, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Sure!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! All the bunnies are gathering
around
you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Where did you all come from? It's
lovely to
meet you, sweet rabbits.

text_block_list.name: Rabbits
text_block_list.text: Hippity-hop-hop!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! That one's running away! I'll get
it to come
back, so—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Actually, never mind! We'll wait
together for the
bunny to come back on
its own!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: All right. ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of time to see everything,
so we
can take the leisurely route!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru... I wouldn't mind if you made a
quick dash
around the zoo by yourself,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You finally got over your cold, and this
is your first outing since then. I'm sure
you're eager to
see everything you
possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I tend to move at a slower pace, so it
might be
more fun for you if you took a
quick zip around
by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But everything's much more fun with you
by my
side!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Well, I often fall sick, which means I'm
usually stuck in the infirmary. Last time
was the same too.
I'm hardly ever in our
room.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You even helped me pick an outfit for
our outing today. Not that I could wear
it because I spilled
juice all over it... I
was just so excited to spend time with
you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm super happy that we can hang out
together
like this! So, really, let's take
our time and enjoy
ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My... I'm touched. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sun's setting as I head to the cafe. I
spy the same pair from earlier in the day,
but the mood
has shifted since this
morning.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... We sure played hard today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Are you all right? Here, have some tea.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Thanks...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: YEOWCH!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. I'm sorry... I knew it would take
me a long time to carry our drinks back
to our table, so I asked them to make
everything as hot as they
could.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want you to get cold and
become sick
again...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that's so considerate! Thank you
so much!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But really, I should be apologizing! It's
my fault
we couldn't see everything we
wanted at the zoo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm just happy to be here with you, and
see you
hale and hearty...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Truly... I'm happier than you could ever
know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So I guess that means we both feel the
same way.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Aww... Yeah! Exactly the same!
